releaseNotes: Added Advanced TV Compatibility Checker in Settings with real decoder, HDR, refresh rate, RAM, storage, and HOME launcher diagnostics.
Added Automatic Error Detection & Safe Auto-Repair engine for IPTV playlists, network endpoints, and launcher state.
Added Universal QR Code URL Input System with authenticated local LAN/relay sessions for M3U, Online Video, GitHub Repo, and Backup URLs.
Rebuilt IPTV Live TV section integrating Indian-IPTV-App (kananinirav/Indian-IPTV-App) stream catalog, multi-playlist manager, favorites, recently watched, and HLS.js recovery.
Added VLC-Style Online Link Player supporting M3U8, MP4, WebM, playback speed (0.5x-2.0x), aspect ratio, audio/subtitle tracks, and history.
Added KP TV Updates manager with SHA-256 verification and native Android PackageInstaller support.
